note: Superior National Forest (Tofte district) rustic campground on Fourmile Lake, about 12 miles northwest of Tofte on Forest Road 170. Pull-in sites not designed for RVs: two of the four are longer than 21 ft and may take a 23-ft rig. Boat ramp and dock with trailer parking; the two boat-in backcountry sites on the shore are separate. No garbage pickup: pack everything out. --Claude
